title: What's New: E-Documents Connectors (2025 release wave 1)

features.name: Logic E-Document Connector
features.description: New e-document connector providing electronic invoice handling capabilities. Available from Business Central version 26.0 in public preview for 1 month, then general availability from 26.1.

features.name: Continue E-Document Connector
features.description: Upcoming e-document connector planned for release in Business Central 26.2. Code review nearly complete.
caveats: Not yet available; will be published on AppSource

features.name: AppSource E-Document Connector Installation
features.description: New capability to install e-document connectors directly from AppSource within Business Central. Users can browse available Microsoft-published connector applications and install them with a single click.
caveats: Requires navigating to E Document Services list page first

features.name: E-Document Service Integration Setup
features.description: Unified setup experience for all e-document connectors. Users select a connector from available options and configure it through a consistent interface, regardless of which connector is chosen.
caveats: Configuration details vary by connector provider

features.name: Multiple Global E-Document Connectors
features.description: Strategy to provide multiple globally-available e-document connectors. Previous releases had Pag and Avalara; 2025 wave 1 adds Logic and Signup, with Continue planned for 26.2.
caveats: Local connectors available only through AppSource by local providers
